svg.title: Growing contribution snake for boyfeiyu
svg.desc: Starts with 3 segments. Each first visit to a green day eats that day and adds one segment. Empty or previously eaten cells do not grow the snake. Ends with 33 segments, then resets the calendar and snake together. The darker head has eyes; the gold dot marks the tail.
svg.text: START 3 · 30 GREEN DAYS · FINAL 33 · +1 PER EATEN GREEN DAY
